question.prompt: Which criterion do you use to place your business income and expenses in a tax year? Accrual (devengo) is the usual answer.
question.help: Accrual (devengo) is the usual answer: income and expenses belong to the year they arise, whatever the payment date. Cash (cobros y pagos) is an election open only if you do not keep Código de Comercio accounting (RIRPF art. 7.2); it binds you for at least three years and is stated in your return. If you are not sure, leave this blank: the activity boxes stay unresolved until you state it.

choices.label: Accrual (devengo)
choices.description: The usual answer: income and expenses count in the year they arise, whatever the payment date.

choices.label: Cash (cobros y pagos)
choices.description: Only if you elected it in your return and do not keep Código de Comercio accounting; it binds you for at least three years.

year.prompt: Which tax year (ejercicio) is this answer for? Enter four digits.
year.help: The election is made year by year, so the answer is saved for that year only and the answers for other years stay as they are.

accounting.prompt: Do you keep accounting under the Código de Comercio (required or voluntary) in that tax year? If you do, cash is not open to you.
